name: release
description: 奶龙发布跑书：产物上传 → 远端产物完整性核对 → 服务端仓库同步 → deploy/release.sh overlay 发布 → 健康与镜像核对 → 日志留档。前置：本机已跑 docs/build-release.ps1 生成 docs/release-<sha>.tar.gz，且该提交已推送到服务端能 fetch 的远端。脚本本体仍在仓库（deploy/release.sh），本文件只是步骤 + 断言 + 参数，不含任何逻辑。

steps.description: 参数闸门：必须显式传入 sha
steps.script:
if [ -z "${sha}" ] || [ "${sha}" = "<sha>" ]; then
  echo '缺少参数 sha：先在本机跑 docs/build-release.ps1 生成产物，再用 runbook_params 传 sha=<7位短提交号>' >&2
  exit 2
fi
echo "release-param-ok sha=${sha}"

steps.description: 上传本地产物 docs/release-${sha}.tar.gz → ${releases}/${sha}.tar.gz（上传后校验 sha256）
远端产物完整性：条目数 ≥ 50 且关键切片齐备
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
TARBALL="${releases}/${sha}.tar.gz"
[ -f "$TARBALL" ] || { echo "artifact-missing $TARBALL" >&2; exit 3; }
N=$(tar -tzf "$TARBALL" | wc -l)
echo "artifact-entries=$N"
[ "$N" -ge 50 ] || { echo "artifact-too-thin entries=$N" >&2; exit 4; }
LIST=$(tar -tzf "$TARBALL")
for want in main.js index.html schema.prisma entrypoint.sh seed.js package-lock.json; do
  echo "$LIST" | grep -q "$want" || { echo "artifact-missing-member $want" >&2; exit 5; }
done
echo artifact-members-ok

steps.description: 服务端仓库同步到该提交（fetch + 只允许快进 merge，不留游离 HEAD）
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
git -C "${repo}" fetch --all --prune
git -C "${repo}" cat-file -e "${sha}^{commit}"
echo "server-commit=$(git -C "${repo}" log -1 --format=%h ${sha})"
git -C "${repo}" merge --ff-only "${sha}"
echo "repo-head=$(git -C "${repo}" rev-parse --short HEAD)"

steps.description: 核对服务端 HEAD 就是产物对应的提交
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
A=$(git -C "${repo}" rev-parse HEAD)
B=$(git -C "${repo}" rev-parse "${sha}")
[ "$A" = "$B" ] || { echo "repo-head-mismatch HEAD=$A want=$B" >&2; exit 6; }
echo "repo-head-ok ${sha}"

steps.description: 执行 deploy/release.sh ${sha}（guard → 回滚快照 → overlay 构建 → 重建 server → 冒烟）
核对运行镜像与回滚快照 pre-${sha}
steps.script:
set -euo pipefail
docker ps --filter name=nailong-server --format '{{.Image}}  {{.Status}}'
docker images nailonghub-server --format '{{.Repository}}:{{.Tag}}'

steps.description: 记录应用日志尾部（现场留档，失败不影响发布结论）
